Name: ZH's Artisanal Goods Plus - Animal Husbandry
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/4TUZUbk.png[/img][/center][left]Add-on mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods+[/url] for [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Digus?gameId=1303]Digus[/url]﻿'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url], it can be used without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods+[/url]﻿ but made to match with it. Yes, they aren't artisan goods, but I thought this was best mod series to put it in.[/left]
This mod, like my others, is completely [i]configurable[/i]. Anything you don't like or want, you can simply disable


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/lcEmWaN.png[/img]﻿
For anyone that may be wondering, this is what's[i] [/i]covered in this mod:[/center][u][b]Meat (Animal Products):[/b][/u]
Beef, Chicken, Duck, Mutton, Ostrich, Pork, Rabbit

[u][b]Tools:[/b][/u]
Feeding Basket, Insemination Syringe, Meat Cleaver, Meat Wand, Participation Ribbon


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/4fl2KWq.png[/img]﻿[/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url]
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/EDggbvX.png[/img][/center]
